//: Electron runs a preload script inside the sandboxed renderer with a CommonJS wrapper. An ESM preload is only loaded when sandbox is false, so emitting the app's ESM output here would silently expose nothing on window -- measured: window.hafDesktop was undefined on both Electron 41.7.1 and 44.4.5. This project keeps sandbox: true, so the preload is emitted as CommonJS and renamed to .cjs (the package is "type": "module").
